name: Workspace files read-only MCP
summary: Expose bounded read-only workspace file inspection through a locally pinned MCP server.
description: Installs a local stdio MCP server that reads regular UTF-8 files, lists directories, and searches file names only beneath the current workspace, with fixed result budgets and no network or secret authority.
refuses: It does not read paths or symbolic-link targets that resolve outside the current workspace.
It does not write, delete, rename, execute, upload, or otherwise mutate workspace files.
It does not access network services, environment secrets, Git internals, or toolkit state directories.

entrypoints.purpose: Serve the pinned bounded workspace inspection tools over local standard input and output.

mcpServer.trustBoundary: Only bounded regular files and directory names inside the canonical current workspace cross the server boundary; symlinks and toolkit state are excluded.
